note: Fix: DTD Jackpot dashboard reopened itself after closing (had to close twice). openDash() runs several async render() calls (one per RPC) and each re-added the 'show' class; a late RPC re-showed the dashboard after the user closed it. Added a _dashOpen guard: render() only shows while the dashboard is intended open (set true on openDash, false on close). Verified with a headless simulation of the real code. Also: callout is clickable, +35% size, card pulse, 15s/15s cycle.
